name: Mine Protection
author: SCUMSA
description: Punishes players who arm a mine or trap outside their own or their squad's flag area: a chat warning first, then a teleport onto their own mine. Squad-aware, never acts on a guess. Clears the mines a fallen flag leaves behind and the mines no flag covers any more, and lets you remove mines by type, placer, flag, sector or age. Every clean-up is off until you switch it on.

needs.why: Confirms a mine is STILL armed in the running game in the moment before its placer is teleported onto it. Without this, 'armed' is whatever the last game save recorded, so a mine defused since then still counts as one.

Checks who is in the placer's squad right now. Squad membership also comes from the last save, so a player who joined a squad since then is punished for a mine legally placed inside their new teammate's base.

wants.why: Loads a fallen flag's area when nobody is near, so its mines can be removed with the server empty.
